name: Navy peach floral knit dress
description: Short-sleeve scoop-neck knit dress with a muted navy ground and dense cream, peach, and sage florals. Stretch jersey, likely a fitted/bodycon silhouette.
rating_reason: Muted florals read Soft Autumn, but navy is cool and the clingy knit will map hips without a waist. Fine as a throw-on if it does not cling; otherwise skip.

name: Charcoal puff-sleeve smocked dress
description: Dark charcoal midi with a deep V/surplice bodice, voluminous elastic-cuff puff sleeves, a wide smocked waist, and a gathered skirt. Matte cotton or linen-blend look.
rating_reason: Near-perfect pear architecture (shoulder volume, V-neck, defined waist), but charcoal/black is too cool and heavy for Soft Autumn. Keep if the fabric is warm-grey; otherwise wear with warm jewelry and a rust cardigan.

name: Terracotta ditsy tank dress
description: Sleeveless jersey tank dress in muted rust with a tiny white ditsy print, deep scoop neck, and wide straps. Visible hole near the lower front.
rating_reason: Color is a Soft Autumn hero and wide straps help balance hips, but jersey can cling and the hole makes it chore-only unless repaired. Not capsule-worthy as-is.

name: Sage off-shoulder ruffle dress
description: Muted sage jersey midi with an elastic off-shoulder neckline and a large ruffle/flounce that reads as flutter sleeves, then a simple straight skirt.
rating_reason: Sage is textbook Soft Autumn and the ruffle adds upper-body volume for a pear. Knit is easy mom fabric; off-shoulder is less barn-practical but great for church, photos, and summer evenings.

name: Terracotta tiered long-sleeve dress
description: Solid burnt-orange/terracotta long-sleeve knit dress with a modest crew neck, smocked cuffs, and a loose tiered skirt from mid-torso down.
rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn color and homestead-practical (coverage, movement, one-and-done). No waist cinch so it is not the most pear-defining; a belt or cardigan would lift it to staple-plus.

name: Burgundy velvet wrap dress
description: Deep burgundy velvet wrap with a V-neck, short puffed sleeves, self-tie waist, and midi/maxi length. Slight sheen.
rating_reason: Wrap + V-neck is excellent for a pear, but this burgundy is cool and saturated versus muted Soft Autumn, and velvet is church/date not chickens. Keep as an occasion piece, not a daily staple.

name: Heather grey jersey sheath dress
description: Cool heathered-grey long-sleeve jersey dress with a simple crew neck and a straight, body-skimming sheath cut.
rating_reason: Cool grey fights Soft Autumn and a clingy sheath highlights hips with no waist. Comfortable, but it will not earn its hanger in this capsule.

name: Black bodice medallion maxi
description: Sleeveless maxi with a solid black tank bodice, waist tie, and a full skirt in a muted dusty-rose, cream, and tan medallion/boho floral on a dark ground.
rating_reason: Skirt palette is Soft Autumn and the tie defines the waist over hips. Black bodice is harsh; still a useful one-and-done if layered with a camel cardigan at the face.

name: Black tie-waist tank maxi
description: Solid black jersey tank maxi with wide straps, modest scoop neck, and a self-tie waist that gathers the fabric. Full length.
rating_reason: Tie waist is pear-friendly and jersey is easy, but true black is too stark for Soft Autumn and will show dust, flour, and animal hair on a homestead.

name: Olive scoop-neck tank
description: Sleeveless tank in muted moss/olive with wide straps and a deep scoop neck. Soft solid jersey.
rating_reason: Olive is a Soft Autumn staple and a wide-strap scoop draws the eye up. Tucked into a high-waist skirt or jeans it is a daily homestead layer.

name: Dusty sage heather tank
description: Light dusty sage/mint heather tank with wide straps, simple round neck, and a straight relaxed hem.
rating_reason: Muted green mostly works though it leans a touch cool. Basic pear layer—needs a tuck or open cardigan. Keep as a summer undershirt.

name: Tan ditsy floral maxi skirt
description: Lightweight midi/maxi skirt with a ruffled elastic waist and a small-scale ditsy floral on muted tan, flecked with dusty blue, burgundy, and olive.
rating_reason: Palette is Soft Autumn textbook, elastic waist plus flowy A-line is ideal pear, print hides stains, and it moves with kids and farm days. Hero capsule piece.

name: Dusty rose Mama Bear tee
description: Heathered muted rose crewneck tee with a white 'Mama Bear' script, bear silhouette, and heart graphic. Soft jersey, relaxed fit.
rating_reason: Dusty rose is a strong Soft Autumn mom color; straight tee needs a front tuck or knot for a pear waist. Playful and washable—keep one, not a pile of graphics.

name: Tomato-red Kampout 2023 tee
description: Bright warm tomato-red crewneck tee with a rectangular 'Best Time Ever / KAMPOUT 2023 / GRACE POINT CHURCH' graphic in white and pale blue-grey.
rating_reason: Saturated true red is too bright for muted Soft Autumn and the boxy graphic tee does nothing for a pear waist. Keep as a memory/PJs piece, not in the capsule.

name: Heather navy V-neck tee
description: Muted dusty heather navy V-neck short-sleeve tee with marled flecks and a simple relaxed cut.
rating_reason: Heathered navy is more wearable than jet black for Soft Autumn, and a V-neck helps a pear. Not a color hero, but a solid layering tee if tucked.

name: Heather grey MAMA raglan
description: Cool medium heather-grey long-sleeve raglan with a ribbed crew neck and vertical white 'MAMA' print.
rating_reason: Cool grey and a straight raglan are meh for Soft Autumn and pear. Sentimental and cozy for chores; not a wardrobe building block.

name: Black crewneck sweatshirt
description: Solid black crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem, boxy relaxed fit. Visible lint and pilling.
rating_reason: Black plus pilling plus homestead lint is a losing combo, and Soft Autumn looks better in oatmeal or cocoa. Boxy volume can balance hips, but this specific piece is a replace-not-keep.

name: Grey All of Life for Jesus tee
description: Muted heather medium-grey crewneck tee with a dark 'ALL of LIFE for JESUS' serif/block graphic.
rating_reason: Faith message fits the home, but cool grey is only a fair Soft Autumn neutral and the straight tee needs a tuck. Keep if worn often; do not build the capsule around it.

name: Black tiered high-low tank
description: Solid black sleeveless round-neck tank with a double-layered, slightly high-low tiered hem.
rating_reason: Black is harsh on Soft Autumn, and a flared/tiered hem adds volume right at the hips—the opposite of pear strategy. Easy pass.

name: Heather grey muscle tank
description: Basic athletic heather-grey tank with a high round neck, wide straps, moderately deep armholes, and a straight hip-length hang.
rating_reason: Useful for workouts or under a flannel, but cool grey and a shapeless muscle cut are not capsule-priority for Soft Autumn or pear.

name: Charcoal heather tank
description: Dark charcoal heather sleeveless tank with a scoop neck and a straight, untailored casual fit.
rating_reason: Too close to black for Soft Autumn and no waist. Keep only as a cheap layer under a warm cardigan; oatmeal tanks in this batch replace it.

name: Oatmeal Awaken graphic sweatshirt
description: Muted heathered oatmeal crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed trim and a large circular black 'Awaken / coffee, matcha and chai' botanical graphic.
rating_reason: Oatmeal is a Soft Autumn hero and a relaxed top balances hips. Black print is a bit stark but the base color and cozy homestead vibe make it a strong staple.

name: Oatmeal heather scoop tank
description: Muted heathered oatmeal/taupe tank with a ribbed modest scoop neck, wide straps, and a relaxed straight cut.
rating_reason: Warm oatmeal beats white or black as a Soft Autumn base. Tuck into jeans or a floral maxi for pear waist definition; year-round layer.

name: Sandy beige scoop tank
description: Light sandy beige sleeveless tank with a deeper scoop neck and medium-thin straps. Lightweight drapey jersey; a waffle cardigan is behind, not the focus.
rating_reason: Earthy beige is excellent Soft Autumn and a deeper scoop lifts the eye. Same job as the oatmeal tank—keep the better-condition one if they duplicate.

name: Ivory scoop-neck tank
description: Light cream/ivory deep-scoop tank with thin straps and a slightly textured lightweight knit. Photographed in front of a camel waffle cardigan.
rating_reason: Ivory is warmer than stark white so Soft Autumn can wear it, but thin straps and a pale scoop are less homestead-practical (sun, straps slipping). Good under the waffle cardigan.

name: Camel waffle-knit cardigan
description: Open-front long-sleeve cardigan in muted warm tan with a chunky waffle/honeycomb knit, wide ribbed trim, and two large patch pockets. Relaxed fit.
rating_reason: Camel is a Soft Autumn cornerstone, open front makes a vertical line and defines the waist over hips, pockets are mom-functional, and NW Arkansas shoulders need this most of the year. Hero layer.
